decisive_items: Classic-appearing hyperkeratotic lesion with many pseudohorn cysts
Proliferation of neoplastic squamous cells originated from one lateral end, pushing down into the dermis and involving many hairs
Malignant squamous cells contained eosinophilic cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli; mitotic figures were present
response.rationale: The histopathological examination reveals characteristic features of squamous cell carcinoma, including a hyperkeratotic lesion with pseudohorn cysts and proliferation of neoplastic squamous cells.
